notes.title: Patch 1.2.0
notes.content:
[h3]Lök here![/h3]

Hopping in with an update.

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

[h2]Polish Translation[/h2]

With the help of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Klamos/]Klamos[/url] who volunteered to translate [b]My Boss Leidi[/b], our game is now available in [b]Polish[/b]! We're thankful for the work that they have done to make the game available in more languages for more people to enjoy.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]

By request, we've also added some achievements for fun. This was something we considered before the Steam release but didn't go through with it until now because we were unfamiliar with the interface. I figured it'd be best to do them now at the same time as the translation build. We're pretty happy with how they turned out. We hope you guys enjoy them!

That's all for now. If there are any more updates, we'll make sure to post them here.

Until next time.

Cheers!
